text: Welcome to the Uganda Revenue Authority. How can I help you today?
Value Added Tax is charged at eighteen percent on the supply of taxable goods and services.
You can register for a Tax Identification Number online at the URA web portal.
Pay As You Earn is deducted monthly by employers from employee salaries.
To file your tax return, log in to your URA account and select the Returns tab.
Penalties for late filing include a percentage of the outstanding tax and interest charges.
Rental income is taxable and must be declared on your annual return.
For personalised advice about your specific tax situation, please contact URA customer service directly.

Tukwanirizza ku URA. Nkuyambe ntya leero?
Omusolo gw'emigaso gusasulwa ku busigo bw'obuwumbi kumi n'omunaana ku bintu n'obuweereza.
Osobola okwewandiisa ku nnamba y'omusolo okuyita ku mutimbagano gwa URA.
Omusolo gwa PAYE gusalibwako buli mwezi okuva mu ssente z'abakozi.
Okusindika lipooti y'omusolo, yingira mu akkaawunti yo eya URA.
Ebibonerezo ku lutalo okulwawo mulimu ekitundu ky'omusolo n'amagoba.
Ssente ezifunibwa mu kupangisa zisasulirwako omusolo.
Kulaba obubaka obutuufu, tukubire URA butereevu.
Sikakasa, nsaba okakase ne URA nga tonnaba kukola kintu.
Weebale okukozesa URA Tax Assistant. Weeraba.
